entities.name: Adolf von Rhemen zu Barensfeld

entities.summary: Colonel General Adolf Freiherr von Rhemen zu Barensfeld, sometimes referred to as Baron Rhemen, was a German senior officer in the Austro-Hungarian Army, known for his commanding roles during the First World War.
